title: Game
description: A browser-based game I'm building and hosting on its own subdomain. Still a work in progress, so expect rough edges and frequent changes.

title: Better Desmos
description: A single-page graphing calculator: type math like on paper, drag sliders, plot curves and inequalities in 2D and surfaces, space curves and implicit surfaces in 3D, draw vector fields with arrows or streamlines at a chosen spacing, and explore 4D shapes as 3D slices with a w slider and 4D rotation, and get exact derivatives, integrals, gradients, divergence and curl.
